subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw add an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` text writer for session workspace files now, or keep workspace file editing out of core until the broader workspace mutation contract is decided?
rationale: The patch is bounded and proven, but it deliberately opens a new Gateway write path under a workspace root while current main keeps workspace browsing read-only until a separately reviewed mutation contract exists.

options.title: Approve Narrow Session Writer
options.body: Accept the admin-only session text writer after rebasing it onto current main and preserving the shared fs-safe workspace helpers and current viewer contracts.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Require the writer to save only already previewed or transcript-touched text files if arbitrary text-path creation under a session workspace is broader than intended.

options.title: Defer To Workspace API
options.body: Pause this PR and make workspace editing part of the broader full workspace-management API discussion tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Session Writer
recommendation.body: Accept the admin-only session text writer after rebasing it onto current main and preserving the shared fs-safe workspace helpers and current viewer contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main read-only workspace viewer work and are the clearest related product/security owner in the recent history.
